column1: # The Binding of Isaac: Repentance (Nicalis' engine on NVN, SDK 12.3.3), base game v0 (the NACP's display version C1.4.1&M1.4.6).
# This profile is the provisional one scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py generates for this title (survey of the game's own files with
# dm/games/profile_guess.py, the modules row as the build's NRO collection leaves it), written into dm/games with one deliberate
# difference: display_wide is on, a probe of whether the game sizes its picture from nn::oe's default display resolution
# (hle_oe.c h_oe_DefRes). Every other row holds the provisional's value, checked against the build that shipped as gc-237:
# its survey lines, the rewrite tables' build IDs in the shipped app and the device log of that build.
# The game's own patches are in patches.py beside this file (the directory-entry comparator cut, NRO build 8821c0a7).
# subsdk1 (NintendoSDK_movie) is loaded because the NROs the game loads at run time import from it, which main does not
# With the fullscreen setting on, nn::oe reports the host's render width (2344x1080 on the phone) at the docked height
# instead of 1920x1080. Whether this engine sizes its frame from that answer is unmeasured: from the provisional profile
# it has only ever rendered 1920x1080, which the present then stretches to the screen (measured on the iPhone: the
# picture stretched 1.221x horizontally). On as a probe; the answer is in the device log (default display resolution,
# the present's picture shape and crop).
# main sets a heap of at most the pool - 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: no virtual address memory
